title: Unnamed Suit 032
summary: Unnamed Suit 032 is a Suit working with Klaus within in the Organization at the site of the Tomb of Nefertiti in Egypt.

sections.heading: History
sections.wikitext:
This Suit was a part of the archaeological team sent to [[Valley of the Kings, Egypt]] under [[Klaus]] to uncover the [[Tomb of Nefertiti]]. As Klaus recognized Dante's team and initiated an attack, this Suit invoked his [[Sekhmet]] and then attacked [[Sophie Casterwill]], who defeated him with a kick to the face. The team of Suits nearly overpowered Dante's team, but they managed to escape. {{source|All Work and No Pay}}

Lok later distracted him and [[unnamed Suit 031]] with a puzzle that he claimed was found within the tomb while [[Zhalia Moon]] took a map from [[unnamed Suit 036]]. He and a team of Suits later caught up to Dante's team in the Tomb of Nefertiti, but noted that he had no space to invoke his Titan. Dante's team, however, got away. Upon catching up to Dante's team at a pool, he invoked Sekhmet to fight against [[Sabriel]] and [[Lindorm]]. {{source|The Sceptre Deception}}

full_text:
Unnamed Suit 032 is a Suit working with Klaus within in the Organization at the site of the Tomb of Nefertiti in Egypt.

== History ==
This Suit was a part of the archaeological team sent to Valley of the Kings, Egypt under Klaus to uncover the Tomb of Nefertiti. As Klaus recognized Dante's team and initiated an attack, this Suit invoked his Sekhmet and then attacked Sophie Casterwill, who defeated him with a kick to the face. The team of Suits nearly overpowered Dante's team, but they managed to escape. [All Work and No Pay]

Lok later distracted him and unnamed Suit 031 with a puzzle that he claimed was found within the tomb while Zhalia Moon took a map from unnamed Suit 036. He and a team of Suits later caught up to Dante's team in the Tomb of Nefertiti, but noted that he had no space to invoke his Titan. Dante's team, however, got away. Upon catching up to Dante's team at a pool, he invoked Sekhmet to fight against Sabriel and Lindorm. [The Sceptre Deception]

== Abilities ==
This Suit and his team were given desert-based Titans by the Organization.

===Bonded Titans===
* Sekhmet
